resources.string: EsBlock detects Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts screens and sends you back, so you can still use messages, profiles and normal videos. It only reads screen element names and never stores or sends any data.
Block the scroll. Keep the rest.
Turn on the EsBlock accessibility service to start blocking.
EsBlock is watching for short-video feeds.
Everything runs on your phone. EsBlock has no internet access and collects nothing.
